name: Shannon Chen
title: Shannon Chen — Product Designer
description: UX and product design portfolio themed around running. Digital and physical product case studies.

about.headline: About
about.body: Hello! I’m Shannon, a product designer and student at UC San Diego studying Cognitive Science with a specialization in Design and Interaction and a minor in Computer Science. I design digital and physical products that help people overcome barriers and help businesses grow, pairing every design decision with the impact it will have and the metric that proves it.
about.extended: You’ve met little runners throughout my portfolio because running taught me to work harder than my competition, to put in extra time outside of practice, and to slowly chip away at a goal I set for myself months in advance.

hero.intro: Hello! My name is Shannon and I'm currently studying Human Computer Interaction and Computer Science at UC San Diego. Let me show you around!
